use_cases: Displaying status indicators such as 'new', 'sale', or 'popular' on product cards
Showing category labels or tags in dashboard views and data tables
Indicating notification counts or alert badges in navigation headers
Marking items as active, inactive, or pending in list views
Labeling dashboard metrics or sales performance indicators
ai_summary: A versatile badge component with multiple style variants including default, secondary, destructive, and outline modes. Designed for displaying status labels, category tags, or notification counts in live sales dashboards and data-driven interfaces. Features smooth hover state transitions for interactive feedback and integrates seamlessly with Tailwind CSS utility classes.
